images.revised_prompt:
Create a single vertical 9:16 clean photographic frame, macro close-up, realistic premium skincare commercial photography. Use the attached images as visual references for the same fictional adult East Asian woman, matching natural warm light skin tone, realistic pores, neatly manicured natural nails, and an ivory silk sleeve edge visible at the wrist. Show hands only: exactly one right hand and exactly one left hand/palm, anatomically correct, natural fingers, no extra digits or limbs.

ACTION PEAK / CONTACT INSTANT: The right hand holds a detached glass dropper steady between the fingers. The dropper has a matte black rubber bulb, polished gold collar, and clear glass pipette. The pipette tip is approximately 2 cm above the open left palm. A single clear water-like drop has just touched the center of the left palm and is flattening into a tiny wet bead on the skin; the pipette tip is empty because the drop has fully left it. The bead has only a natural sharp specular highlight, no glow, no magical effect, no splash.

Setting: same elegant evening vanity atmosphere as the references, with warm amber key light from screen left, cool blue-hour light from a window, blurred autumn foliage and city tones deep in the background, dark slate/marble surface below, rich navy and gold palette. Very shallow macro depth of field, focus locked on the empty pipette tip and tiny wet bead on the palm, realistic hand texture and reflections in glass and gold. Composition clean and premium, one uninterrupted frame.

No face, no bottle, no additional objects, no text, no captions, no logo, no watermark, no collage, no grid. Ensure the drop is visibly already on the palm rather than hanging from the tip.
